about.title: Making parts in Houston for 72 years
text: Hunt & Hunt has been making parts in Houston since 1954, growing from a small machine shop into a high-volume precision manufacturer.
Our team designed and built seven rotary laser machining centers in-house, and our motto is “cutting into the future.”
Sourcing, manufacturing, warehousing and worldwide distribution come from a single source, backed by our internal research and development program.
